messages:
eva: Quick sync — planning to flip the new precision toggle for the 'mixed-light' profile to 1% canary tonight. Need a quick ops + safety sanity check before I open the gate.

sam: Sounds good. What's the escape hatch if we see quality regressions?

eva: We have precision_fallback_v2 that routes to fp16 variant. It should be a single config flip in the rollout service. Also console kill-switch exists under project -> rollouts -> mixed-light -> emergency-off.

choi: Who's owning the telemetry alerts? We should have automatic rollback if LMQA metric drops > 2% and latency P95 increases by > 30ms for 5m window.

marta: I can wire alerts. I'll create a pager rule for: lmqa_delta > 2% OR p95_delta > 30ms across the canary. Will also add a dashboard panel for token-level error rate.

eva: sweet. Can you also add a small smoke eval set (10 prompts) to run every 10m against the canary? Quick script below:
```bash
# run smoke eval against canary
python infra/evals/run_smoke.py --profile mixed-light --targets canary --evalset smoke_10
```

sam: PR for the rollout config is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-configs/pull/412 — needs one more review and an infra stamp for prewarm.

choi: pinged on the PR. Two notes: (1) prewarm: add --kv-cache-warm=true to the job template, (2) circuit-breaker threshold should be 50 concurrent requests for canary pool.

marta: noted. Also recommend limiting the canary audience to only internal users + 1% external traffic. Add a tag in the feature flag: audience=[internal, external:1%].

eva: agree. One more ask — please confirm we have a plan to backfill logs for quick root cause. We need per-token traces for at least the 100 first requests to the canary.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline kicked: rollout-configs/pr-412 -> staging -> canary. Prewarm job queued (gpu-pool-2). ETA 18m.

sam: I'll watch logs during rollout. If I see LMQA drift >1.5% I'll hit eva directly.

choi: added the kv-cache warm flag to the job template in the PR. Also added a guard to fallback immediately if token error rate > 0.5%.

marta: dashboard and pager rule created: https://grafana.redwood/board/rollouts/mixed-light. Alert policy set to notify #eng-oncall and @eva.

eva: thanks all. Plan: open gate at 23:30 UTC, monitor 30m, escalate if alerts fire. If all green, we'll expand to 5% next day at 03:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

sam: :eyes: will be ready.

marta: LGTM from monitoring side.

choi: LGTM from infra + safety guards.

eva: merging PR and flipping flag in 15. Will post update when canary live.

deploy-bot: rollout started: mixed-light -> canary (1%). Canaries: 120 instances prewarmed.

sam: live — seeing initial requests. latency P95 stable so far.

marta: smoke evals passing 9/10 (one mismatch on a generation length). Investigating whether it's acceptable.

eva: keep me posted. If mismatch persists > 3 eval runs, we'll fallback.

choi: one more note for record: documented kill-switch steps in runbook -> rollouts -> mixed-light -> rollback. Added code snippet for console and CLI usage.

marta: alert fired at 23:42 UTC: p95 increased by 35ms for 6m. Pager delivered.

sam: saw it, initiating rollback via feature flag.

eva: flipping precision_fallback_v2 now.

deploy-bot: rollback completed. Canary disabled. Traffic routing restored to fp16 variant.

eva: postmortem action items: 1) tighten smoke eval pass criteria (require stability over 3 consecutive runs), 2) reduce initial canary concurrency from 1% to a max of 50 concurrent, 3) add token-level golden checks for top-20 prompts. I'll create the follow-up tickets.

choi: I'll also add a playbook step to run a manual baseline comparison pre-rollout.

marta: created tickets: INF-824 (smoke eval stability), MON-331 (dashboard tweaks), ROLLOUT-77 (audience caps).

eva: thanks team — great quick ops. Closing this thread after follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
